summary: Zoned Properties, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its real estate purchase and sale agreement with Broken Arrow Herbal Center, Inc. and assignee 2148 Chino LLC. The company, through its subsidiary Chino Valley Properties, is selling three Arizona properties; the amendment reduces the Chino Property purchase price by $800,000 to $7.2 million and grants a $70,000 credit for a tenant security deposit. Closing is set for August 31, 2026, with 2148 Chino paying cash and Chino Valley covering all closing costs. The Green Valley and Kingman properties already closed on June 30, 2026. The deal represents a partial divestiture of non-core real estate, with no financing contingencies. Watch for closing completion and any extension to September 30, 2026.
